notes: GAAP city, FYE 9/30/2025. Governmental receipts/disbursements/fund balances from Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p6; report p34). ending_cash 34,919,446 is from the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p5, report p32; added after the v8 re-trim): pooled cash 33,333,531 + cash at county treasurer 1,585,915; beginning_cash is null (no prior-year governmental balance sheet in the report); balance_sheet uses the government-wide Statement of Net Position Totals 2025 column (p3), which includes the internal service fund in governmental activities. Business-type receipts/disbursements from the Proprietary Funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, Combined Utilities column (p8); internal service fund column excluded (governmental activities, not in governmental funds statement). Business-type totals are not printed as single totals, so receipts = operating revenue + nonoperating income items (excluding interest expense) and disbursements = operating expenses + interest on bonds, computed. Capital contributions 1,033,053 -> business_type.other_financing; Transfers (Out) 157,716 -> transfers_net. Governmental fund transfers in 4,211,705 less out 4,053,989 = 157,716 net from the utilities (ties to p8 and p9 cash-flow transfers). Taxes line (21,346,018) is a combined line with no breakdown on the fund-basis statements (statement of activities p4 is accrual basis and totals differ), so kept as taxes (unlabeled). Debt Service expenditure lines combine principal and interest (recorded as debt service principal, review). Detail: budgetary-basis schedules (pp11-12, 14-18) recorded with actual and final budget; expenditures are by function only so detail_category is not itemized. Budget-basis actuals differ from the GAAP statement (e.g. General Fund taxes). The nonmajor combining statement (p13) was not recorded in detail to avoid double counting with the budget schedules, and the budget schedules cover the same funds. Detail revenue figures were checked against listed totals. Pages 1-2, 19-22 (MD&A text, combining utilities cash flows, statistical tables) hold no additional receipts or disbursements used. p10 (cash flow reconciliation, report p39) ties proprietary ending cash 29,506,655. Read pages 1-22 of 22.
